roadmap.note: Grab side strands the moment they unlock. WAiNK-scan every new vehicle and study animals through binoculars as you go — the 100% list later asks for 200 of 277 vehicle models and 100 of 255 animals, and anything you do now already counts toward it.
roadmap.title: Phase 1 — Play the story

roadmap.note: The checklist shows up under Progress > Stats once the story is over. It covers nearer 60% of the game — most side quests are not on it. Every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest is required, plus 70 of the 80 challenges.
roadmap.title: Phase 2 — The 100% checklist

roadmap.note: Strangers & Freaks strands are not on the checklist, so they are usually what remains, along with any trophies that did not pop by themselves. Every trophy's quest giver is still in free roam after the ending.
roadmap.title: Phase 3 — Strangers & cleanup

warnings.text: There is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — that is 10 of your 15 manual save slots. (PowerPyx)
Cheats only unlock after the story, and they turn off trophies and saving. Keep them away from your platinum save. (PowerPyx)
Do not pick up the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent and makes the police more aggressive. (PowerPyx)
Some strands are locked to one character: Andy is Lucia-only (Chapter 3 onward); Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only (Chapter 3 onward). (GameMapa, PowerPyx)
Some optional missions expire (hourglass icon). They do not feed any trophy, so losing one is not a platinum problem. (GTA Spotter)
